datasets.title: How many recalled vehicles were actually repaired
datasets.what: One row per campaign in the authority's annual completion-rate list: vehicles recalled, and the share repaired by the eighth quarterly report. Every row is cross-checked against the bulk file and any that disagrees is excluded and counted.
datasets.source: NHTSA annual list of recall completion rates, read from the PDF itself

datasets.title: Every UK recall since 1992, from the DVSA file
datasets.what: One row per DVSA recall reference: launch date, make, models, concern, vehicles listed, how many times this site has caught the wording being rewritten, and the page that keeps every version. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
datasets.source: DVSA, Check vehicle recalls, RecallsFile.csv, read daily

datasets.title: The same recall, Britain and abroad
datasets.what: Every UK recall matched by manufacturer reference to an American campaign, a Canadian recall or a European Safety Gate alert, with both dates and the gap in days. One row per UK recall with at least one match.
datasets.source: DVSA RecallsFile.csv joined to NHTSA, Transport Canada and Safety Gate on the maker's own reference

datasets.title: How long manufacturers take to tell owners
datasets.what: One row per manufacturer: the median and ninetieth-percentile gap between a defect reaching the regulator and owners being written to, across every American recall since 2010 that carries both dates.
datasets.source: NHTSA, FLAT_RCL_POST_2010 bulk file, read in full

datasets.title: The same part, recalled again and again
datasets.what: Every model-and-part combination with more than one separate recall campaign against it in the United States. One row per combination.
datasets.source: NHTSA, FLAT_RCL_POST_2010 bulk file, read in full

datasets.title: What each recall notice said, and when we read it
datasets.what: One row per campaign held in the wording archive, with the hour it was last read and a SHA-256 of the text at that moment. The hash is what makes a later rewrite provable.
datasets.source: NHTSA recalls API, re-read on a rolling cycle

datasets.title: Recalls that tell owners to stop driving
datasets.what: Campaigns whose own remedy text tells owners not to drive the vehicle, or to park it away from buildings, until it is repaired.
datasets.source: NHTSA recalls API, swept by campaign-ID prefix

datasets.title: The same defect, scored in two languages
datasets.what: Campaigns matched across the American and Dutch registers, with a severity score for each country’s wording of the same defect and the gap between them.
datasets.source: NHTSA and the Netherlands vehicle register, matched on manufacturer code and year

datasets.title: How long Dutch owners waited to be told
datasets.what: Per reporting party: the median, ninetieth-percentile and worst gap in days between a manufacturer declaring a defect to the Netherlands vehicle register and owners being informed.
datasets.source: Netherlands national vehicle-register open data, recall actions (j9yg-7rg9)

datasets.title: The same recall, filed in two countries
datasets.what: Campaign pairs we believe describe one defect in both the American and Dutch registers, with both countries’ own words for the consequence, and the years each was filed.
datasets.source: NHTSA and the Netherlands vehicle register

datasets.title: Notices that were rewritten after they were published
datasets.what: Every American recall notice caught changing after publication, with the full text as we read it before and the full text after, and the hour of each reading.
datasets.source: NHTSA recalls API, re-read on a six-hour cycle

datasets.title: A fingerprint of every American recall notice
datasets.what: One row per campaign in the whole NHTSA register: the first eight characters of a SHA-256 of the defect, consequence and remedy text, the day we first read it, the day we last read it, and how many times we have seen the text move since.
datasets.source: NHTSA, FLAT_RCL_POST_2010 bulk file, read end to end

datasets.title: The record, counted by manufacturer
datasets.what: One row per manufacturer whose recall notices we hold, with how many of its campaigns have a dated copy here. This is an index of our own holdings, not of the register.
datasets.source: Our own archive of NHTSA notices, grouped by the manufacturer named in each notice

datasets.title: Recalls that were never completed
datasets.what: By manufacturer: how many recalled vehicles are still recorded as unrepaired, and what share of the total that is.
datasets.source: Netherlands national vehicle-register open data, recall completion figures
